58/G.goal: Explain why VR rendering is computationally demanding and how VR software architectures and GPU parallelism support its efficient implementation.
58/G.achieves: It gives the learner a foundation for analyzing resource requirements and optimization strategies when developing an XR system.

58/O1.goal: Explain how the 3D graphics pipeline, rasterization of points and lines, and VR content requirements such as anti-aliasing and dynamic realism increase rendering computational complexity.
58/O1.achieves: It lets the learner identify where VR rendering work is created and why it becomes a resource demand that later optimization must address.

58/O2.goal: Explain how layered VR software, graphics APIs, and GPU parallelism enable the efficient implementation of graphics pipeline stages.
58/O2.achieves: It helps the learner understand which software components and hardware capabilities an XR system depends on to achieve real-time rendering.
